svg.title: odysseusai - Odysseus, prebuilt, tested before it ships
svg.desc: A star chart with the publish pipeline plotted as a course, from upstream main through the patch, image smoke test and Compose stack checks to an amber star at ghcr.io, where the image is tagged latest, main and its CalVer version.

text.tspan: Stable and dev images built from upstream Odysseus and
booted with the full stack first. Then docker compose up -d.
